issues.description: The recipe class is named LibxextConan instead of the conventional LibxtstConan. The name was inherited verbatim from the verified libxtst/6.1.0 base recipe (which itself inherited it from the libxext lineage); the class name has no runtime effect on Conan packaging.
issues.fix_suggestion: Optionally rename to LibxtstConan in a follow-up revision; no functional change is required for this PR.

issues.description: The build() method carries the libtool .la placeholder/rewiring logic with a device-local /storage/Users/currentUser fallback path, inherited from the verified libxtst/6.1.0 recipe. All branches are guarded by existence checks and were exercised by the passing W3 conan create; the CI-proven branch is the dependency-derived placeholder generation.
issues.fix_suggestion: Keep as-is for consistency with the verified libxi/libxfixes/libxtst 6.1.0 family recipes; a future family-wide cleanup could extract the shadow-.la logic into a shared helper.

summary: W4 audit of libxtst 1.2.5 at audit input SHA-256 8727316af5c99f6b5997e33ae4d7108b3213449ed9e8b5a7d3d4d0bc92a35518. PASS with P0=0 and P1=0. The 10-file diff is confined to archives/l/libxtst/ (single-software atomicity W2/JC6 respected), contains no binaries, tarballs, or forbidden state files, uses the official xorg.freedesktop.org archive URL with a device-verified SHA-256 (b50d4c25b97009a744706c1039c598f4d8e64910c9fde381994e1cae235d9242), and declares exactly the published ohpcd dependency graph (libx11/6.4.0, libxext/6.4.0, libxi/6.1.0, libxfixes/6.1.0, libxau/1.0.11, xorgproto/2025.1) - all verified downloadable via conan install --build=never. The recipe validates os in (Linux, OHOS) per R32, uses Conan 2.x APIs, sets cpp_info.libs=[Xtst] with full cmake/pkg-config properties, and leaves no TODO placeholders. test_package/test.c resolves the real XTestQueryExtension symbol via a signature-matched function pointer and conditionally invokes it when an X display exists, satisfying R34 (non-empty test); the W3 L1e destructive negative test (lib/ and include/ moved away) independently confirmed the consumer genuinely depends on the packaged library. Local W3 conan create passed with exit_code=0 (libXtst.so.6.1.0 packaged, Build Summary 1/1 success, L0/L1/L4/L5 all pass). A latent NameError in the 6.1.0 base recipe's first _la_map rewrite loop (undefined _fp) was fixed in this recipe. The two findings above are non-blocking style notes inherited from the verified family recipe.
